name: Xenia
author: sd88me
summary: An emulation of the Microwave XT wavetable synthesizer's original firmware (gearmulator's 68k and DSP56300 emulators) for Gen2 MPC devices, with a PLAY page laid out like the XT's front panel, two skins, ROM banks, a patch browser, named favourites and Q-Link control on every page. Gen2 (aarch64) only; you need your own Microwave XT ROM.
